Attributed 600-dpi print-ready recreation of [[Astromech Shortage]], from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. It prints a gold E mark; the official full face at [[Astromech Shortage (PC Errata 3)]] prints D-E1. The nav-computer replacement words correspond, but this is a qualified comparison rather than an exact official source face or another Players Committee publication.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Astromech Shortage _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AUJhZr-PaPY7mSwDQsvUbWitNwHyC4sI/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Astromech Shortage _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,416 bytes, SHA-256 <code>839247524e918e2a9f5bc2c9e21f483bdc7b9c5cd43572e52dafbed70f68b114</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The official D-E1 full face remains [[:File:ANH-D-astromechshortage.gif]]. This attributed recreation is retained as a separate comparison; its original TIFF, credit and conversion history remain below.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
